children: Cloudastructure entered into an Exchange Agreement with Streeterville Capital to swap a partitioned $63,332.50 promissory note for 18,246 shares of Class A common stock. The partitioned note was carved out of a June 30, 2026 promissory note originally totaling $1,299,870, reducing its outstanding balance by $63,332.50. On the Free Trading Date, the partitioned note will be canceled, and no additional consideration was paid. The exchange was conducted under the Section 3(a)(9) exemption.
: Exchange Agreement for partitioned promissory note (debt-for-equity swap)
: One-time exchange; note canceled on Free Trading Date
: Reduce debt and simplify capital structure
